title: seal_v2 (design only — NOT a seal instance)
description: Format definition for the next-generation pre-V1 commitment seal. This file is a schema, not a seal; it contains no file hashes, no signatures, no keys, no timestamps. Canonicalization: CANON(x) = json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')) + '\n', UTF-8; H(x)=hashlib.sha256(CANON(x)).hexdigest(). Detached signatures cover the RAW BYTES of the seal file, not CANON(...), so a third party can verify from the bytes received.

items_sha256.description: H(subject.items). Content binding; recomputable with hashlib only.

predecessor_seal_sha256.description: Optional hash chain: sha256 of the PREVIOUS seal file's raw bytes. Gives content-forced partial order without any clock (ORDERING_EVIDENCE.md:275 rule 2). null on first use.

items.description: Each covered file. Field names mirror lead/cert_realcheck_20261109/_cr_seal.json:1-40 (file_sha256/bytes/evidence_lines/evidence_span_sha256/anchor).

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path. Verifier resolves under its own root; never trust an absolute path from the seal.

output_manifest_sha256.description: H(INPUT_MANIFEST) of the labelling/adjudication inputs. Must be disjoint from V1 outputs (ORACLE_SPEC.md:112 T3).

time_anchors.description: At least two DIFFERENT sources AND at least one carrier outside A's write domain. fs_stat alone is weak local metadata: on this host st_ctime is creation time, mtime>ctime is normal after overwrite (verified in _sv_probe_readonly.py C/D), and os.utime can set mtime. Never use fs_stat alone for ordering.

kind.description: fs_stat/rfc3161/transparency_log are machine-checkable; witness_archive/independent_receipt are institutional and MUST NOT be reported as cryptographic.

carrier_outside_A_write_domain.description: ACL fact, not a claim. Must be true for at least one anchor (T8, _os_ORACLE_SPEC.md:182). A log on this machine cannot set this true.

observed_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC. For fs_stat this is derived from the LOCAL clock and is writable; for rfc3161 it is TSA genTime.

imprint_sha256.description: messageImprint in the TSQ — must equal sha256(seal_file_raw_bytes). Binds the token to THIS seal, not to a neighbouring one.

log_operator.description: Must be an entity whose write ACL excludes A.

t0_pre_registration_sha256.description: H(P): SHA256 of the canonical pre-registration package (ID_REG + A_REG + LABEL_SPEC + 302-item list + kappa threshold + coverage=1.0 + isolation plan). Published at t0, BEFORE V1.

seal_bytes_sha256.description: sha256 of THIS seal file's raw bytes, published out-of-band. The seal MUST NOT contain its own hash (no self-reference).

carrier.description: Locator on a carrier whose write ACL excludes A. A gist under the SAME account as A does not qualify.

t1_labels_sha256.description: commit-then-reveal: H(labels) submitted at t1, before revealing plaintext.

predicate_run_anchor.description: INDEPENDENT t2 anchor for the FIRST V1 run, produced by a party other than A. Without this, t0<t2 has one writable endpoint and 'seal before V1' is not established.

signers.description: Per-shard authentication material (T6, _os_ORACLE_SPEC.md:180). One shared string per seal is a FAIL. Detached signatures cover the raw seal bytes and are verifiable with public keys only.

public_key_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the PUBLIC key / cert. The trust anchor is published out-of-band at t0, never read from the local keyring at verify time.

key_generated_by_this_run.description: A seal build must NEVER generate a key. Keys are provisioned separately with approval.

payload_sha256.description: H of everything except payload_sha256 and signers[].signature_*: a content digest of the assertion, for cheap comparison. It is NOT the published 64-hex; the published value is sha256 of the seal FILE's raw bytes.

cryptographic_claims.description: e.g. content_integrity, key_binding, non_malleability_after_signature, tsa_genTime (only if TSA token verified).

institutional_only_claims.description: MUST include 'adjudicator_did_not_see_V1_outputs' and 'key_to_person_mapping'. ORACLE_SPEC.md:123/:161/:163: these are not decidable from artifacts.

unverified.description: Anything not actually run in this build (e.g. TSA POST, rekor inclusion proof). Never silently drop.
